GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up Two Wide Outside Lead at 1100m, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , Dropped Out in straight. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # worked hard early
Jumped ok Settled Down 6 Lengths off the lead Caught deep though & no cover (800m), Under Pressure not going anywhere into the Straight , no run on # Wide no cover all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide without cover, throughout. After the race, noted to have lost the near fore plate.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th 5 Lengths 7th x 600m 10 Lengths off Tearaway Leader Good Pace on, Ridden Along Turning for home clear run home Outside with 1st Outside it both in Best Going had its chance - # run ended 100m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th Outside 5 Lengths out 3 Wide x 600m Four Wide Turning for home asked to go at the 300m, into Lead x 100m run down x line, # Sound eff. 58.5

Jumped well Straight to the front soon headed took the trail behind Leader fence 2 Lengths (1400m), travelled well 600, off Inside Soon After & cruised up on terms into the Straight , took over below 300, couldn't get away, swamped Inside last 50m missed place! # led 50m/swamped!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced in restricted room for a short distance leaving the 500m and was struck on the nose by whip.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Straight To The Front Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Joined x 800m again led x 1 Lengths @ 500m but now Ridden Along , new challenger Turning for home dueled, Kept Finding - # wouldn't lie down

Jumped ok Wide out pushing on Settled Down Two Wide fourth 4 Lengths (1400m), fluched out 3 Wide 650 now in line of four, hit lead into the Straight albeit narrowly, still led 100 looked home however winner got him late # looked the winner
Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, No Match when Leader extended from the 400m and he was under riding, chased bravely last 200m and held second spot # brave chase

Jumped Ok Restrained to slot in Settled Down 4th Outside 4 Lengths no trail but was Outside winner, Under Pressure x 400m, Soon After Couldn'T Go On - J.McMurray was replaced on this mount.....Apprentice J.McMurray when directed to reweigh by Clerk of Scales Mr. Fletcher he threw his saddle in his direction of Mr. Fletcher and used profanities when speaking to Mr Fletcher - # battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 200m, was bumped and became unbalanced.
